verdict.rationale: Rive documents reusable components. These are reusable artboards whose instances update automatically when the source component changes, but the docs scope them to a single Rive file. Nothing in the pack shows a shared library that publishes components or styles across files or projects, or a controlled, opt-in update flow. Missing for 10: cross-file and cross-project library publishing, shared styles or tokens, controlled (accept/review) updates when the source changes, and independent corroboration.
